items.title: Ben Kelly Interview, 1960-08-11
items.q: Sam Robinson. Yeah. That was the clarinet player.

ctx.x: famous so he just put it down. Do you remember his name? Yeah. Called him Norwood. What was the name again? No, Norwood. Norwood. Yeah. Oh, no. Norwood. But he put it down. He didn't stay with it? No. Do you remember who he had then later?

Didn't use no. Didn't use clarinet or something? No. All he used was trumpet, big instruments, baritone, solo alto, voice alto, drum. This is the brass band you're talking about? Yeah, the brass band. Now in the string band which they had, they used clarinet. But that's uh, he's dead and gone. That's uh, Jim Riddler, uncle. Sam Robinson. Oh, Sam Robinson. Yeah. That was the clarinet player. Was that a brother of Jim Robinson's, the trombonist, his brother? Yeah. His brother. Yeah. He told us a little bit about…

I know he's dead. I know he's dead. Long time. Yeah. Nice youngster. Nice youngster. Can you tell us uh, any more about Chris? People tell us that he used a lot of mute sometimes. Yeah. Or maybe a rubber plunger, you know, one of those rubber things. Yeah. Do you know when he picked those up when he started on that? Huh? When did he start to use those? Did he use those down the country too? No. Just after he come up here.
